summary: Iteration 4 — code-review remediation regression. Backend: 88/88 pytest passing across backend_test.py + test_batches.py + test_iteration3.py (no regressions after audit() signature change, qa_decision/enter_results/create_coa/coa_pdf_bytes/batches_csv splits). Frontend: full auth persistence + binary downloads validated. AUTH REFACTOR: (a) login works for admin/qa/qc, (b) wrong password shows 'Invalid email or password' via [data-testid=login-error], (c) full page reload keeps user signed in (no bounce to /login), (d) direct deep-link navigation to /batches, /qa-queues and /audit all resolve to the target page and do NOT redirect to /login, (e) logout redirects to /login and afterwards /batches deep-link redirects back to /login. BINARY DOWNLOADS with in-memory token + httpOnly cookies: export-batches-btn downloads batch-report-2026-08-13.csv both immediately after fresh login AND after a hard page reload; download-coa-pdf-btn-COA-IT3-14CE8A16-ALL-R1 downloads COA-IT3-14CE8A16-ALL-R1.pdf both fresh and after reload. BATCHDETAIL SPLIT: batch-detail-page, batch-number, batch-status-badge, batch-production-date, batch-shelf-life, batch-expiry-date, batch-spec-version, batch-customer, batch-instrument, batch-results-body, batch-history-list, coa-section and qa-actions all present on a released batch. QA Queues page renders qa-queues-page + queue-awaiting-review + queue-on-hold + queue-to-send. Specifications page shows Save buttons for QA. Samples search input works. Dashboard renders KPIs + chart + recent records + SHELF-LIFE ALERTS card for QA and QC.

ui_bugs.issue: React console error 'Encountered two children with the same key ... Missing result for a specified parameter'. The refactor replaced array-index keys with the reason string itself, but hold_reasons can legitimately contain the same string multiple times (one per missing parameter) so the key collides. Same latent risk in required_actions.map. Fix: use `${idx}-${r}` or a hash+idx key.

action_items: BatchHeader.jsx: change hold_reasons.map((r) => <li key={r}>) and required_actions.map((r) => <li key={r}>) to use a stable non-colliding key (e.g. key={`${i}-${r}`}); duplicates like 'Missing result for a specified parameter' currently emit a React duplicate-key warning.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext.login only sets user + access_token on success; if the backend response schema ever changes (e.g. missing access_token), setAccessToken(undefined) will silently keep the previous in-memory token — consider defensive `setAccessToken(data.access_token ?? null)`.

In-memory token is scoped to a single tab. Open a second tab and the second tab starts with no Bearer token; it depends entirely on the httpOnly cookie surviving. Verified working (cookies present), but any future CORS/domain change that breaks the cookie will now silently break cross-tab auth without an obvious signal.
batches.py is still 942 lines — the split reduced complexity of individual functions but the module is well over the 700-line limit. Recommend the same batches/ package split flagged in iteration 3.
BatchHeader duplicate-key warning above is the only user-visible artefact of the array-index-key removal; otherwise the refactor is clean.
seed_data_creation: None new in this iteration; pytest run created the usual IT3-* / IT3PW-* / IT3SUP-* + TEST_ batches from prior test files.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth is now httpOnly cookies + in-memory Bearer fallback. /api/auth/me is called on every AuthProvider mount, so reload works transparently. If future iterations touch AuthContext or the axios interceptor, retest: (1) fresh login → reload → still logged in, (2) deep-link paste to /batches or /qa-queues without login state → still works, (3) CSV export + COA PDF download both fresh-session and post-reload. React duplicate-key warning in BatchHeader is the only outstanding item and does not block any functionality.
